listing.name: Twisted Metal III — TwistedMetal1234Recomp (jcoker85)
listing.summary: Experimental project. This is the native TMIII profile. Complete TMIII setup/play and Rev0 compatibility have not been independently confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS1 USA TwistedMetalIII SCUS94249 Rev1 CHD or CUE/BIN; other game profiles not substitutes.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the shared Windows launcher and tools/generate.sh setup, selecting tm3 with your own Rev1 disc. The runtime uses OpenBIOS and reads original disc data.

warnings: This is the native TMIII profile. Complete TMIII setup/play and Rev0 compatibility have not been independently confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
